items.text: Hello, PC & PCVR players, you haven’t been forgotten! The VR experience has gotten a complete graphics overhaul. The new version of VR mode on PC is now much more performant so if you’ve had any issues running it before, now is a good time to give it a new try.

On flatscreen mode we decided to roll back to using Unity’s own SSGI instead of the previously implemented GI solution. This leads to the lighting looking a bit different in some areas. The decision was made because of unsolved compatibility issues on some systems and to make the project easier to maintain.

If any of you prefer the look or feel of the earlier version of POOLS either in flatscreen or VR, we will leave it up to be downloaded from Steam (instructions at the end of this message). Personally we prefer the look and performance of the latest update though!

(VR) Disabled transparent material screen space reflections because of compatibility issue with water surface shader

We are investigating and pursuing performance optimizations with the goal of switching the rendering mode to multi-pass rendering in the future. Screen space water reflections do not have the misalignment issue when using multi-pass rendering, but it does come with a larger performance overhead when compared to the currently active single-pass instanced mode.
Thank you very much for the VR related feedback and every bit of support we've received thus far! We'll continue fixing bugs and working towards those performance improvements.
Also - VR support will be added to the Demo version hopefully tomorrow. We'll post an update about it once it is available.

notes.title: The Chapter 0 Beta version is now updated!

notes.title: How to access the Chapter 0 beta

items.text: (Currently available for owners of the game here on Steam - Window or Linux - no VR support yet.)
1. Right click the game in Steam and open the Properties window
2. Open Betas-tab
3. Type "chapter0beta" without the quotes into the text field and click the button next to it
4. Click “opt into chapter0beta”
5. Steam should then download the beta build of the game for you

releases.displayName: VR Beta update - all chapters now available for owners of the game

items.text: We're pleased to report that owners of the game now have access to every chapter in VR Beta!

The full release of PC VR mode is scheduled for early 2025. If you want to jump in early, you can do so through our special VR testing branch on Steam. Thanks to everyone who has already tried the VR Beta and left us immensely valuable feedback.

notes.title: How to access the VR beta in Steam

items.text: Right click the game in Steam and open the Properties window
Open Betas-tab
Type "poolsvrpublicbeta" without the quotes into the text field and click the button next to it
Click “opt into vr-beta-public”
Steam should then download the VR beta build of the game for you
You can opt in & out of the beta version from the “Beta participation” drop down menu whenever you like
Note: VR is only available for Windows version at the moment. Unfortunately Unity game engine doesn't support building with OpenXR on Linux.

notes.title: VR Beta feedback, discussion and bug reports

items.text: Feel free to have VR mode related discussion, feedback and thoughts on Steam Forums.
If you wish to leave feedback anonymously, we’ve created a Google Form where you can give your thoughts about the VR mode.
You can also always contact us at our Discord-server or via e-mail at support(at)tensori.fi

We're especially looking for feedback on how the VR mode works with different types of VR devices, such as Valve Index or Pico VR headsets. We’ve developed and tested the game using Meta Quest 2, 3 and a PlayStation VR2 headset on PC, so any comments about the play experience and SteamVR input rebind tool on different devices is incredibly helpful.

The VR mode has a suite of comfort and accessibility settings. We’d love to hear if you are able to find a combination of these settings that allows for a comfortable VR experience. If you’d like to see a new setting added to the VR mode, please let us know about it on this thread, feedback form, Discord-server, or e-mail.
Have fun!
Tensori

notes.title: Notes about V-sync and target frame rate

items.text: In main menu screen, V-sync is disabled by default and target frame is locked to 60. This is intended behavior to prevent unnecessary system load.
In loading screens, V-sync is disabled by default and target frame is locked to 30.
If V-sync is enabled, the game's target frame rate is determined by the window mode setting and display resolution setting:
Fullscreen: target frame rate is current display resolution selection's maximum refresh rate
Borderless windowed and windowed: target frame rate is the maximum supported refresh rate of your display regardless of the resolution selection
